sources.title: Starbucks: Q3 fiscal 2026 results
sources.supports: US comparable sales rose 7.9%, with comparable transactions up 4.2%. The question concerns sustaining growth, not assuming an ongoing sales decline.

sources.title: Starbucks: 2026 Investor Day strategy
sources.supports: Starbucks described café investment and Smart Queue sequencing across ordering channels.

sources.title: Two years of Back to Starbucks
sources.supports: The company reports launching Smart Queue, investing in staffing, and restoring the coffeehouse experience.

sources.title: Dutch Bros: Order Ahead
sources.supports: Customers can place orders in the Dutch Bros app for pickup at participating shops; availability depends on the location.

sources.title: Dunkin: mobile app
sources.supports: Dunkin promotes ordering ahead and rewards through its app.

sources.title: Dunkin: September 2026 tailgate offers
sources.supports: The September page promotes a $6 breakfast Meal Deal. This is evidence of value positioning, not a guaranteed January 2027 price.

sources.title: Dutch Bros Q2 2026 results
sources.supports: Quarterly revenue $550.9 million; company-operated same-shop sales +8.3% and transactions +3.4%.

sources.title: Starbucks company history
sources.supports: Founded in Seattle in 1971; evolution from bean merchant to coffeehouse.

sources.title: Dutch Bros company overview
sources.supports: Founded by Dane and Travis Boersma in Grants Pass in 1992; drive-through beverage model.

sources.title: Dunkin company overview
sources.supports: Founded in 1950; more than 14,000 restaurants in nearly 40 markets.

sources.title: Inspire acquisition of Dunkin Brands
sources.supports: The $11.3 billion transaction placed Dunkin within Inspire; this is transaction value, not current brand revenue.

sources.title: National Coffee Association specialty consumption research
sources.supports: 47% of adults consumed specialty coffee in the past day; 36% of past-day specialty coffee drinkers had coffee prepared outside home versus 23% of traditional coffee drinkers.
